text: Residents of Adanac Drive advised my office of sightline issues on the curve just west of Bellamy Rd. S., when cars were parked on both sides. At my request, Transportation Services conducted a review and found that sightlines were limited and could be improved. Therefore, I am requesting a parking by-law amendment as per Transportation Services recommendation.

The Scarborough Community Council: 1. Prohibited parking at all times on the south side of Adanac Drive, between a point 43 metres west of Bellamy Road South and a point 47 metres further west / south.
